note: AI rule constants exposed as live sliders.. Edited by Claude (curated from DeepSeek batch D TUNABLES census + own capstone checks). tools/gen_rules.py verifies every site against the exe and writes dll/abl_rules.h; the panel reads this file for labels. Order = slot index (append only).

rules.label: Blue-flag yield radius (m squared; 625 = 25 m)
rules.help: A lapped AI car starts making room for the lapping PLAYER inside this squared distance (race only). 100 = 10 m, 2500 = 50 m.
rules.source: investigations/ai_interaction_role/README.md 2026-08-18 blue-flag diagnosis; capstone 2026-10-03

rules.label: Side-step offset, mode 2 (m)
rules.help: How far a car asked to side-step (Overtaking mode 2) moves its line. Lapped cars and qualifying traffic use it.
rules.source: Overtaking 0x42AF70 store; IR 2026-08-18 'Exact Overtaking lateral-offset mode values'

rules.label: Side-step offset, modes 1/7/8 (m)
rules.help: Same as above for the other side (modes 1, 7, 8).
rules.source: Overtaking 0x42AF70 store; IR 2026-08-18

rules.label: Traffic throttle cap (x difficulty)
rules.help: While a car has an interaction target (yielding / side-stepping) its throttle is capped at difficulty x this. 1.0 = no lift.
rules.source: AISteeringCorrection 0x426CF0 (fmul then fstp 0x457C); IR 2026-08-18 6593

rules.label: Off-track throttle above 90 km/h
rules.help: When an AI car is off the racing corridor (+1.5 m) and not braking, the game holds its throttle at this value until it is back on track. 1.0 = full throttle rejoin (risk: spins on grass).
rules.source: AIRacingLine 0x425920 L302-326: on_track 0x445C = inside line corridor + 1.5 m; off track and no braking -> throttle target 0.5 (> 25 m/s) or 0.4 (<= 25 m/s). Live 2026-10-03 Coulthard: 0.50 flat while on_track 0, 1.0 once back on.

rules.label: Off-track throttle at 90 km/h or less
rules.help: Same rule for slow cars (at or below 25 m/s = 90 km/h).
rules.source: AIRacingLine 0x425920 L302-326: on_track 0x445C = inside line corridor + 1.5 m; off track and no braking -> throttle target 0.5 (> 25 m/s) or 0.4 (<= 25 m/s). Live 2026-10-03 Coulthard: 0.50 flat while on_track 0, 1.0 once back on.

rules.label: TC kicks in below grip
rules.help: Traction control acts when the smoothed wheel grip (1.0 = full grip) drops below this. 0 = traction control OFF. Higher = earlier, more cautious.
rules.source: AISteeringCorrection 0x426CF0 (decompile L24-66; exe disassembly 0x426D14-0x426E92); DeepSeek phase3/TRACTION_CONTROL.md (Monza: active 5.4 % of samples, 1st-2nd gear)

rules.label: TC cut steepness
rules.help: How hard the cut grows as grip falls: depth = 2 x (1 - this x grip), clamped 0..1. Game 1.111 = no cut at 0.9, full cut at 0.45. Lower = gentler.
rules.source: AISteeringCorrection 0x426CF0 (decompile L24-66; exe disassembly 0x426D14-0x426E92); DeepSeek phase3/TRACTION_CONTROL.md (Monza: active 5.4 % of samples, 1st-2nd gear)

rules.label: TC only above speed (m/s)
rules.help: Traction control is skipped below this speed (m/s; 4 = 14 km/h) unless the car is stuck. Raise it to allow wheelspin when launching.
rules.source: AISteeringCorrection 0x426CF0 (decompile L24-66; exe disassembly 0x426D14-0x426E92); DeepSeek phase3/TRACTION_CONTROL.md (Monza: active 5.4 % of samples, 1st-2nd gear)

rules.label: TC weight of the worse wheel
rules.help: The two grip readings are blended; this is the share of the WORSE one. With the next slider they should add to 1.0. Higher = reacts to the slipping wheel.
rules.source: AISteeringCorrection 0x426CF0 (decompile L24-66; exe disassembly 0x426D14-0x426E92); DeepSeek phase3/TRACTION_CONTROL.md (Monza: active 5.4 % of samples, 1st-2nd gear)

rules.label: TC weight of the better wheel
rules.help: Share of the BETTER grip reading in the blend (game 0.3). Keep worse + better = 1.0.
rules.source: AISteeringCorrection 0x426CF0 (decompile L24-66; exe disassembly 0x426D14-0x426E92); DeepSeek phase3/TRACTION_CONTROL.md (Monza: active 5.4 % of samples, 1st-2nd gear)

rules.label: TC brake-on-slip gain
rules.help: Brake added = this x throttle removed by the cut (output 0x4028). Never seen firing in 90 559 Monza samples: probably no visible effect.
rules.source: AISteeringCorrection 0x426CF0 (decompile L24-66; exe disassembly 0x426D14-0x426E92); DeepSeek phase3/TRACTION_CONTROL.md (Monza: active 5.4 % of samples, 1st-2nd gear)

rules.label: Steer lift from steering above
rules.help: Throttle is lifted while steering more than this (0..1). 1.0 = steer lift OFF.
rules.source: AISteeringCorrection 0x426CF0 (decompile L24-66; exe disassembly 0x426D14-0x426E92); DeepSeek phase3/TRACTION_CONTROL.md (Monza: active 5.4 % of samples, 1st-2nd gear)

rules.label: Steer lift only above speed (m/s)
rules.help: Steer lift only acts above this speed (m/s; 20 = 72 km/h).
rules.source: AISteeringCorrection 0x426CF0 (decompile L24-66; exe disassembly 0x426D14-0x426E92); DeepSeek phase3/TRACTION_CONTROL.md (Monza: active 5.4 % of samples, 1st-2nd gear)

rules.label: Steer lift amount
rules.help: throttle x (1 - this x steering). Game 0.7: half-lock steering = 35 % less throttle. 0 = steer lift OFF.
rules.source: AISteeringCorrection 0x426CF0 (decompile L24-66; exe disassembly 0x426D14-0x426E92); DeepSeek phase3/TRACTION_CONTROL.md (Monza: active 5.4 % of samples, 1st-2nd gear)

rules.label: Too close behind (m)
rules.help: Closer than this directly behind (overlap under 1.25 m) the AI backs off and treats the car as "hold". Lower = sits closer to the gearbox before deciding (more crash risk).
rules.source: AISteering 0x4270A0 opponent-record loop (decompile L606-629, L668-672, L762, L950-1051; exe sites anchored on the record gap [rec+0x4180], the per-record patience 0x42DC+28k and speed 0x4440); phase3/OVERTAKE_DEFEND.md

rules.label: Back-off when too close (m/s)
rules.help: When too close, the AI aims this much below its own speed. 0 = no back-off (it keeps pushing).
rules.source: AISteering 0x4270A0 opponent-record loop (decompile L606-629, L668-672, L762, L950-1051; exe sites anchored on the record gap [rec+0x4180], the per-record patience 0x42DC+28k and speed 0x4440); phase3/OVERTAKE_DEFEND.md

rules.label: Attack interest range (m per aggression+1)
rules.help: Within (aggression+1) x this metres of a car ahead, attack patience builds up; outside it decays. Game: 40 m at aggression 1.
rules.source: AISteering 0x4270A0 opponent-record loop (decompile L606-629, L668-672, L762, L950-1051; exe sites anchored on the record gap [rec+0x4180], the per-record patience 0x42DC+28k and speed 0x4440); phase3/OVERTAKE_DEFEND.md

rules.label: Patience decay outside range (per tick)
rules.help: How fast the built-up attack patience drains when the car ahead is out of range (40 ticks/s).
rules.source: AISteering 0x4270A0 opponent-record loop (decompile L606-629, L668-672, L762, L950-1051; exe sites anchored on the record gap [rec+0x4180], the per-record patience 0x42DC+28k and speed 0x4440); phase3/OVERTAKE_DEFEND.md

rules.label: Attack threshold (higher = stays in line longer)
rules.help: The AI switches lane (+/-3 m) when its pass-cost score is below this minus the built-up patience. HIGHER = it follows in line longer before pulling out; lower = pulls out early.
rules.source: AISteering 0x4270A0 opponent-record loop (decompile L606-629, L668-672, L762, L950-1051; exe sites anchored on the record gap [rec+0x4180], the per-record patience 0x42DC+28k and speed 0x4440); phase3/OVERTAKE_DEFEND.md

rules.label: Patience cap
rules.help: Maximum built-up attack patience (game caps at 450, so the threshold never drops below 50). Both the compare and the clamp store use this.
rules.source: AISteering 0x4270A0 opponent-record loop (decompile L606-629, L668-672, L762, L950-1051; exe sites anchored on the record gap [rec+0x4180], the per-record patience 0x42DC+28k and speed 0x4440); phase3/OVERTAKE_DEFEND.md

rules.label: Alongside below gap (m)
rules.help: Below this gap (and laterally apart) the pair counts as alongside (modes 7/8); above it the follower is in approach (16).
rules.source: AISteering 0x4270A0 opponent-record loop (decompile L606-629, L668-672, L762, L950-1051; exe sites anchored on the record gap [rec+0x4180], the per-record patience 0x42DC+28k and speed 0x4440); phase3/OVERTAKE_DEFEND.md

rules.label: Patience kept when dropping to approach
rules.help: When the follower falls back to approach, its built-up patience is multiplied by this. 1.0 = keeps it all; 0 = starts over.
rules.source: AISteering 0x4270A0 opponent-record loop (decompile L606-629, L668-672, L762, L950-1051; exe sites anchored on the record gap [rec+0x4180], the per-record patience 0x42DC+28k and speed 0x4440); phase3/OVERTAKE_DEFEND.md

family_help.Yielding: Blue flags: how close the lapping PLAYER must be before a lapped AI car makes room.
family_help.Overtaking & side-step: How far a car moves sideways when it is asked to step aside (and when it attacks: +/-3 m).
family_help.Traffic awareness: The throttle cut while a car is yielding / side-stepping (game 0.75 x difficulty). The cap is never restored by the game afterwards: use "Never cap throttle at 75 %" too.
family_help.Off-track rejoin: Outside the racing corridor + 1.5 m (pure geometry, not grass detection) the AI holds 50 % throttle (40 % at or below 90 km/h) until it is back.
family_help.Traction control: Two wheel-grip readings (1.0 = gripping) are blended (70 % worse wheel), smoothed, and below 0.9 the throttle is pulled toward a safe value, harder as grip falls (full cut at 0.45). Mostly 1st-2nd gear wheelspin.
family_help.Steer lift: Throttle x (1 - 0.7 x steering) while steering more than 10 % above 72 km/h.
family_help.Following & overtake decision: How a follower decides to pull out: within (aggression+1) x 20 m of the car ahead an attack PATIENCE builds up each tick (cap 450) and drains outside; the car switches lane (+/-3 m) when its pass-cost score drops below 500 - patience. Closer than 4 m directly behind it backs off 5 m/s and holds. Alongside = gap under 5.5 m. "Tailgate before passing" sets 1.5 m / 1 m/s / threshold 900.
